title: Wayland (Kwin) MenuBar Popups Can Spawn In The Wrong Location And Even Persist After Minimisation
body: ### Tested versions Producible in v4.7.stable.arch_linux [5b4e0cb0f] and v4.6.3.stable.official [7d41c59c4] Note I am using the arch linux official repo package but checking upstream is 4.7 stable as expected. ### System information Godot v4.7.stable (5b4e0cb0f) - CachyOS Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Sat, 13 Jun 2026 07:50:52 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 SUPER (nvidia; 610.43.02) - AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D 8-Core Processor (8 threads) - 30.22 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono) Operating System: CachyOS Linux KDE Plasma Version: 6.7.0 KDE Frameworks Version: 6.27.0 Qt Version: 6.11.1 Kernel Version: 7.0.12-1-cachyos (64-bit) Graphics Platform: Wayland Processors: 8 × AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D 8-Core Processor Memory: 32 GiB of RAM (30.2 GiB usable) Graphics Processor 1: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 SUPER Graphics Processor 2: AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D 8-Core Processor Manufacturer: Micro-Star International Co., Ltd. Product Name: MS-7E59 System Version: 2.0 ### Issue description Menubar popups can spawn in the wrong location and even persist through minimising the engine. This could very well be a kwin, wayland, x11, or xwayland bug or a combination of any. https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e274491e-5739-45c7-91d5-d9bea7ed5cef Doing some very basic testing, they spawn in in the correct location when the engine is "restored" to the default window size even if it maximised on project launch. but the popup will still persist through minimising godot as in the video. This may be due to spawning the popups under wayland and them not respecting the size of the godot window? Apologies if this is a dupe I'm not super familiar with the compositor terms but I looked, also if this is a kwin issue I can report it to them as well. ### Steps to reproduce Open any project and resize the window, then click on the any item in the menu bar. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) N/A empty new test project
